name: Open a member sub-account
description: Logs in, opens a new sub-account for a member (type, nickname, opening deposit), confirms the irreversible creation step, and reports the new account number.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: Member to open the sub-account for.

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.description: Display nickname for the new sub-account.

inputs.name: openingDeposit
inputs.description: Opening deposit amount in USD; must be >= 25.

outputs.name: new_account_number
outputs.description: Extracting the new account number from the success screen showing the newly created sub-account for member 12345
